Browser adaptation:
  - Extracted Anime25DRenderer, PsdRigLoader, Anime2.5DRig generic parts/rigger, mesh/deformation,
    stencil/FBO compositor, PSD diagnostics, and PSD worker from the pinned tree.
  - Rebased only relative imports from DAEMONLET's src/ tree into vendor/anime25drig/.
  - Kept WebGL1 canvas alpha, per-layer mesh deformation, eye stencil, and ModelCompositor FBO.
  - Added browser loader/worker/bridge under web/rig/src; no Electron, React, IPC, Node, or
    upstream application shell is included in the runtime bundle.
  - ag-psd is consumed as the explicitly pinned npm dependency 29.0.0; see AG-PSD-NOTICE.txt.
  - Browser bundling uses ag-psd's published dist/bundle.js, not its Node entrypoint.
  - A local upstream/package.json marks the unmodified UMD JavaScript files as CommonJS.
  - DAEMONLET-LICENSE.txt preserves the application renderer's separate MIT notice;
    generated browser and native decoder builds also copy the base64-js and pako
    dependency notices.
  - Pilot PSD and alternate pose are Herdr pack inputs. Their provenance and rights are separate
    from these engine notices; no upstream sample art is vendored.

Embedded ag-psd browser closure:
  - The pinned npm package is ag-psd 29.0.0 from
    https://github.com/Agamnentzar/ag-psd; the browser build aliases the
    published `dist/bundle.js`, not the Node entrypoint.
  - An artifact audit of `dist/bundle.js` found the embedded Browserify
    Buffer shim, ieee754, a JPEG decoder derived from jpeg-js, and the
    Browserify util/process closure in addition to base64-js 1.5.1 and
    pako 2.1.0.  Pako's embedded `/lib/zlib` code is covered by the
    supplementary vendor/licenses/PAKO-ZLIB-LICENSE.txt notice.  See
    vendor/licenses/AG-PSD-BROWSER-CLOSURE.txt and its referenced license
    files.
  - The published artifact does not preserve package metadata or commits for
    those embedded modules.  Their versions/commits are intentionally
    reported as unknown; no unverified version is asserted.
  - The JPEG source header says it is based on
    https://github.com/jpeg-js/jpeg-js, Copyright 2011 notmasteryet, and
    Apache License 2.0.  The Apache notice in
    vendor/licenses/JPEG-DECODER-APACHE-2.0.txt preserves that embedded
    header rather than substituting the current jpeg-js repository license.

Native decoder port:
  - native/rig/decoder.ts is a Herdr native-worker port with bounded PSD
    preflight, validation, packing, and transport-facing output around the
    same trusted ag-psd browser bundle and vendored rigger.  It is not a
    browser/WebGL host and does not include the browser HTML or UI.
  - native/rig/build-decoder.mjs retains strict TypeScript checking and emits
    decoder.js plus NOTICE.txt and copied vendor notice resources only.  The
    native output deliberately excludes index.html, browser entry/worker
    bundles, and WebGL host resources.
  - Native-port code and attribution are separate from the upstream
    DAEMONLET and Anime2.5DRig notices above; those notices remain preserved
    unchanged.
